title: Probe and needle on the patient
view: Right neck from above, patient supine, head turned to the left: head at the top, the patient's right (posterior neck) on the image left, as the anatomy plate.
teachingPoint: Probe transverse across the lateral border of the sternocleidomastoid, about 3 cm above the clavicle; needle in-plane from the posterior (lateral) end.
claims: Right neck from above, head turned left; lateral on the image left, the same way round as the anatomy plate.
Linear probe transverse at the interscalene level, across the SCM's lateral border, about 3 cm above the clavicle (record subtitle; NYSORA 2-3 cm, concept).
Needle entering just beyond the probe's posterior end, in line: in-plane from posterior to anterior (record, steps 6).
Two labels: Block needle, Linear probe. On the photograph the SCM border is not drawn: the painted neck does not show it clearly enough to trace.

geometry.why: probe straddles the SCM's lateral border
probe is clear of the clavicle
needle enters at the posterior (lateral) end
head is turned away; the ear is up and lateral
probe lies over the external jugular, as NYSORA places it
